traps: Meridian Partners is a firm, not Meridian Energy: the Warehouse problem on a different name
the businessman, convicted and sentenced, is unnamed in this text and must stay unnamed
'Judge Gilbert': a role and a surname, the court unprinted
'Inland Revenue' as speaker of a release, and as the author's former employer
the quoted lines ('The next quarter will be better.') are typical sayings with no speaker, not quotes from anyone
the author's bio line at the foot is the richest data on him (partner, former IRD solicitor, his practice)
hypothetical numbers ($120,000, $5,000 a month) are an example, not facts about anyone
